# FDG8065

> CONSIDER implementing `IEquatable<T>` whenever overriding `Object.Equals`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.1 Object.Equals.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1066
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion

CA1066 reports a value type that overrides Equals without implementing IEquatable<T>, of any accessibility (probe with SDK 10.0.402); reference types are not reported, so coverage is partial.
